title: 13- Outlier Detection
text:
Note: make sure you have completed Exercise 12 first and that 'shoppings' is defined in the code cell.

Using the 'shoppings' dataframe, create boxplots for 'shoppingcost' and 'shoppingsize'. Do you observe outliers?
answer:
sns.boxplot(shoppings[['shoppingsize','shoppingcost']])
Boxplots show outliers as points beyond the whiskers. Observe if there are extreme values in shoppingcost or shoppingsize.
